entity1.name: Dinosaurs
entity1.description: Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a subject of fascination and study.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a significant subject in both popular culture and scientific study.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the Mesozoic Era, known for their diverse species and large sizes.;;;Refers to large beings or animals that are imagined or theorized to have existed in the past.;;;A group of prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are known for their large size and diversity.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the past, known for their diverse adaptations and physical features.;;;Extinct reptiles that lived millions of years ago during the Mesozoic Era.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the past and are now extinct, known for their large size and diverse species.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are studied to understand ancient ecosystems and evolutionary processes.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are now extinct.;;;A group of reptiles that dominated the Earth during the Mesozoic Era and went extinct approximately 65 million years ago.;;;A group of reptiles that lived during the Mesozoic Era and became extinct approximately 65 million years ago.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a popular subject in scientific and cultural contexts.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that are a popular subject in modern culture, including movies, toys, and video games.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the Mesozoic Era and are now extinct.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a subject of scientific study and public fascination.

entity3.name: Earth
entity3.description: The planet where the creatures roamed millions of years ago.;;;The planet on which humans and other life forms live.;;;The third planet from the Sun in the Solar System, home to a wide range of life forms and geological features.;;;The planet where the described landscapes and ecosystems exist.;;;The Earth as it existed in the distant past, particularly during the time when dinosaurs lived.;;;The third planet from the Sun in the Solar System, and the only known celestial body to support life.;;;The third planet from the Sun in the Solar System, where all the events of life and history take place.;;;The third planet from the Sun in the Solar System, where all known life exists.

entity6.name: Tyrannosaurus rex
entity6.description: A large carnivorous dinosaur known for its massive size and powerful jaws, one of the most iconic species of the Late Cretaceous period.

entity7.name: Brachiosaurus
entity7.description: A massive herbivorous dinosaur with a long neck, belonging to the sauropod group, known for its enormous size and height during the Late Jurassic period.

entity10.name: humans
entity10.description: A species of intelligent, bipedal mammals that currently dominate the Earth.

entity15.name: ceratopsians

entity16.name: dinosaur species

entity18.name: Scientists
